name: scott
_source: Project Gutenberg #11579 — Scott's Last Expedition Volume I (Scott's own journal)
_format-note: Gutenberg formats journal dates as `_Saturday, November_ 4` — month wrapped in italic underscores, day-of-week often included before the month and inside the underscores. Anchors target the closing-underscore pattern '<Month>_ <day>' which matches both the day-of-week and bare-date formats.

entries.title: The Beardmore Glacier
entries._note: Anchored on December 10 (start of Chapter XVII, 'On the Beardmore Glacier' — Camp 32 on the glacier itself) rather than December 9 (Camp 31, last day on the Barrier). The buildPassage stops at chapter breaks so the Dec 9 entry alone is only ~470 words; Dec 10 captures the ascent narrative the archive description asks for.

entries.title: The Last Entry
entries._note: Anchors on the famous 'Message to the Public' (Scott's parting analysis of why the expedition failed and the appeal to his countrymen) rather than the brief 470-character journal entry of March 29. The Message is the substantive document and the more iconic one — written in the tent in Scott's last days.
